raw:
The error occurred in Turn 3, where the VerificationExpert agent miscalculated the number of incorrect papers. The agent incorrectly assumed a 5% false positive rate, leading to a result of 50, when in reality, all papers with an average p-value of 0.04 are significant, resulting in 0 incorrect papers. The mistake was due to a misunderstanding of the p-value implications.
